settings.remoteAccessDesc: Open Acpio from your phone when it shares a VPN or LAN with the PC.
settings.remoteStep1Body: In the project folder run `npm run dev`. The web UI listens on all interfaces (port 5173), the API on 3001. Leave this terminal running.
settings.remoteStep2Title: Connect the phone to the same VPN
settings.remoteStep2Body: Use the same VPN profile as the PC (WireGuard, Tailscale, corporate VPN, etc.). The phone must reach the PC’s VPN or LAN IP — not only the public internet.
settings.remoteStep2HowIp: On the PC: Windows → `ipconfig` (look for the VPN/Ethernet/Wi‑Fi IPv4). On Tailscale — the 100.x address. That IP is what you type on the phone.
settings.remoteStep3Title: Open the UI on the phone
settings.remoteStep3Body: In the phone browser open `http://PC_IP:5173`. Example: `http://192.168.100.209:5173`. Do not use `http://0.0.0.0:5173` — that is only a listen address. `localhost` works only on the PC itself.
settings.remoteStep4Body: The key is optional: without it, opening the address on the same VPN/LAN is enough. If you set one, the phone or another PC will ask for it once (the browser remembers it). The PC itself (localhost) never asks.
settings.remoteKeyHint: Optional. Protects the UI when a phone or another computer is on the same network. Leave empty for no extra lock.
settings.remoteUnlockLead: This server is protected by a key. Enter the same one as in Settings → Phone & VPN on the PC.
settings.remoteTipLocalhost: From the phone always use the PC IP, never localhost.
settings.remoteTipFirewall: Allow inbound TCP 5173 (and 3001 if needed) in Windows Firewall for private/VPN networks.
settings.remoteTipInstall: After the site opens, tap Install in the toolbar (on iPhone — follow the Safari Add to Home Screen steps).
settings.remoteTipSameNetwork: Phone and PC must be on the same VPN/LAN. Different Wi‑Fi without VPN usually will not work.
settings.remoteTipHttp: Dev mode uses HTTP. On some phones Safari may warn about insecure sites — confirm to continue for a local/VPN address.
settings.remoteTipKey: The key is only asked away from localhost. If you set a key and the phone prompts for it, type the same one as in settings on the PC.
